label: late-episode D2 step, mostly when S2 is shown
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only late in the episode: never before trial ~55, onset at trials 60-79, rate 12% at trials 80-89 and 16% at 90-99. It looks like an episode-clock / approaching-the-end feature, and matches the low value-head output late in the episode (51% of mass is in the lowest value bin, none above value 8.1). It is strongly biased toward the reached state S2 (89% of mass; rate 4.9x vs 1.0x for S1), and is strongest when S2 is reached by a rare transition after a1 while S1 is good, though restricting to that case loses most recall. Reward, transition type and stay/switch matter little. It never fires at D1 or GO or in early trials. D2 & ep_trial>=80 alone gives mass recall 0.93 at precision 0.42. Adding S2 gives dev F1 0.70, precision 0.66, mass recall 0.82. Many late S2 D2 steps stay inactive, so precision is incomplete. The predicate uses no future variables.
